glomeris history — Recorded disk-pressure transitions.

usage: glomeris history [--json] [--limit <N>]

Read-only — changes nothing.

A bounded tail of the pressure-state changes the monitor recorded. This is the
machine's disk history, not a record of actions taken — for what was
actually executed, use `actions history`.

Options
  --limit <N>
      How many of the most recent entries to show.
  --json
      Print a HistoryReport as JSON on stdout.

Examples
  glomeris history --limit 20
      Has this been getting worse?

See also: actions, status
